use std::ptr;


pub struct fastdata;

struct E {
    key: u16,
}

impl fastdata {
    const BUCKET_STARTS: [u8; 5] = [
        u8::MIN, 1, 2, 3, 4
    ];

    const ENTRIES: [E; 4] = [
        E { key: u16::MIN }, E { key: 1 }, E { key: 2 }, E { key: u16::MAX }
    ];

    #[inline(always)]
    fn get_hash(value: u16) -> u64 {
        value as u64
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub fn keys() -> impl Iterator<Item = u16> {
        Self::ENTRIES.iter().map(|entry| entry.key)
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub fn contains(key: u16) -> bool {

        let hash = Self::get_hash(key);
        let index = (hash % 4u64) as usize;
        let start = Self::BUCKET_STARTS[index] as usize;
        let end = Self::BUCKET_STARTS[index + 1] as usize;

        for i in start..end {
            let entry = &Self::ENTRIES[i];
            if entry.key == key {
                return true;
            }
        }

        false
    }

    pub const ITEM_COUNT: usize = 4;
    pub const MIN_KEY: u16 = u16::MIN;
    pub const MAX_KEY: u16 = u16::MAX;
